card.name: Words just before a stated similarity
card.fires_on: The word right after a similarity cue, such as "properties" in "Because of similar pharmacological properties", or "and"/"also" in a "both X and Y" or "also highly bound" comparison. The next words are likely to state a similar effect.

modes.label: After similar pharmacological
modes.description: The noun "properties" following "similar pharmacological" in a reasoning clause about drugs sharing risk.
modes.example: Because of similar pharmacological<< properties>>, it is reasonable to expect similar risk

modes.label: Joint-property links
modes.description: A linking word such as "and" or "also" where two drugs are said to share a trait.
modes.example: Both digitalis glycosides<< and>> beta-blockers slow atrioventricular

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words meaning similar or similarly, such as similarity and similar.
card.plain: It marks spots where the text is about to say that two drugs act alike.
